Synthetic 3-second video test patterns, with no user media or audio.
Generated locally with FFmpeg 9.0.1:

ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=10:duration=3 -c:v wmv2 -an thumbnail-codec.wmv
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=10:duration=3 -c:v mpeg4 -an thumbnail-codec.mp4

Purpose: verify legacy codec thumbnail decoding in Chromium and WebKit without
depending on the operating system's native codec availability.
